title: Chapter 536
text:
In the hall of the Hub, Han Xiao was purchasing resources in the shop. Other than fuel and parts for the spaceship, Floating Dragon Island had also gotten him to purchase some items on their behalf when they heard that he was going back.

While he was shopping, his communicator suddenly rang. Han Xiao took it out and glanced at it. He could not help but curl his lips before shoving the communicator back into his pocket and continuing to shop.

After slowly picking out the items and paying for them, Han Xiao watched as the shop assistants moved the fuel and parts onto the hovering aircraft. At this moment, a hovering aircraft stopped in front of the shop.

A staff member of the Hub hurriedly ran down from the hovering aircraft and rushed toward Han Xiao.

"Your — Your Excellency Black Star! Your spaceship … "

Han Xiao waved his hands and interrupted the other party. He smiled and said, "It's fine. Isn't it just a bunch of thieves who wanted to steal my spaceship? How many of them are still alive?"

The staff member was stunned for a moment before nodding. "When we arrived, there was only one person left alive, and he was severely injured. We have already captured him, but your spaceship is still intact …"

"Let's go take a look."

Han Xiao nodded and boarded the hovering aircraft, heading toward the hangar area. The staff member followed behind and arrived at the scene not long after.

The door of the hangar was shattered, and the corridor outside was filled with charred marks. At this moment, many Hub guards were surrounding the area.

Beside the hangar, a burly man was tightly bound by electromagnetic restraints. His battle suit was riddled with holes, and his entire body was filled with wounds. He was on the verge of death.

Han Xiao took a look and saw that the interior of the hangar was a mess. The walls were shattered, and all sorts of wires were exposed. Sparks were falling down like rain, making sizzling sounds.

The lights were flickering, and the ground was stained with blood. More than ten corpses were lying on the ground, covered with white cloth. Only the BlackLight Stealth was obediently parked on the ground. Its shell was as smooth as a mirror, and there was not a single scratch on it.

"This is the guy who wanted to steal my spaceship?"

Han Xiao walked toward the heavily injured Befuli, and his eyes were filled with sympathy.

The Blacklight Stealth was Risda's current body. He had long since received Risda's message and wasn't anxious at all.

These thieves were simply courting death for daring to target Risda. They were about to face a spaceship with sentient life, and it was even the Blacklight Stealth, a high-grade spaceship with superior performance and complete functions.

Even if he had to deal with the BlackLight Stealth himself, it would be much more stressful than dealing with a few Grade B Supers at the same time. Furthermore, there would not be a Calamity Grade Super who would steal a spaceship for no reason. Even if it was a Calamity Grade Super, the BlackLight Stealth would still be able to escape in an instant.

Therefore, Han Xiao was not worried about the safety of the spaceship at all. Unless pigs could fly, it would not be stolen.

"Your Excellency Black Star, we've checked the database. This person is a space pirate from Fawn Galaxy …"

A staff member was holding a PDA with a transparent screen to introduce the situation. Han Xiao didn't wait for him to finish and directly took the PDA.

After taking a look, Han Xiaoxin's head suddenly twitched.

"Befuli, his special ability is to shoot fire from his eyes … Aiyo, aren't those laser eyes? He's actually someone from the Purple Snake Space Pirates … I seem to have dealt with this group of space pirates before? "

Han Xiao recalled that the leader of this space pirate group seemed to be a relatively weak Calamity Grade Super …

Rolling his eyes, Han Xiao lifted Befuli up and said, "This fellow wants to steal my spaceship. Leave him to me."

"It's only right. It's our negligence to have caused you to encounter danger." The staff member nodded.

After dispersing the staff and guards, Han Xiao stepped onto the spaceship, found a room, and threw Befuli heavily onto the ground.

"You dared to act rashly without doing a good job of intelligence gathering. If it were a normal spaceship, you might have really succeeded. You're really unlucky. What do you think?" Han Xiao could not help but tease.

Befuli's wounds were still hurting, and he was in so much pain that he grimaced. He was still in a state of shock.

He had clearly blocked the spaceship's signal, but the spaceship moved as though it had a life of its own. The laser cannons fired continuously, piercing through his combat suit very quickly.

Befuli was only good at attacking, and the flames released from his eyes were unable to block the energy of the laser cannons. Furthermore, physical defense was not his forte, and he was unable to withstand the continuous damage from the laser cannons. If not for the guards arriving at the crucial moment, he would have most likely been shot to death by this strange spaceship.

Now that he had landed in Black Star's hands, Befuli was filled with regret. He did not know what the other party would do to him.

Since Black Star did not kill me, it's most likely because he feels that I have some value. This is good news. He probably wants to interrogate me for information, so I have to cooperate. I have to calm him down and not let him have the intention to kill me! My Esper Ability is very destructive, and as long as Black Star is careless, I will be able to escape!

Befuli's palms were sweating, and all sorts of thoughts flashed through his mind. Although he was a rough galactic pirate, when it came to his life, his mind worked very quickly.

As long as he did not die, there was still a chance!

Han Xiao patted Befuli's shoulder. "You are an officer of the Purple Snake Galactic Pirates, so I will put this debt on Purple Snake's head. I don't have the time to deal with them now, but it's good. After a period of time, my mercenary group will need many targets to practice with, and Purple Snake seems to be a good choice. When the time comes, I will personally look for your leader to play.

"As for you …" Han Xiao looked straight into Befuli's eyes, revealing a playful smile. "Since you delivered yourself to me, don't blame me."

Befuli subconsciously felt a chill run down his spine. Before he could think about what Han Xiao meant, he suddenly felt a pain in his arm. Black Star took out a disc-shaped machine and pressed it against the blood vessels in his arm. There was a slight pain, as though a needle had been inserted.

"This is …"

Before Befuli had the time to be confused, he suddenly felt his strength rapidly draining away. Bright red blood gradually accumulated in the empty slot of the disc-shaped machine. He could not help but widen his eyes, and a sense of weakness arose.

His Esper Ability had already become a part of him, just like his arms and legs. However, at this moment, Befuli's sense of his Esper Ability was gradually weakening, as though he was losing his Esper Ability. This way, his last reliance was gone.

"What's going on?" Befuli's expression changed drastically, and he panicked. The current situation was beyond his expectations.

Super Gene Extractor!

In the past year, Han Xiao had rarely used this juicer, mainly because he had not caught any villains. The previous Rezar had already been sucked dry, and there was no way for him to continue developing. Thus, Han Xiao helped Rezar get rid of it.

Now, other than occasionally squeezing his own juice to store Ability Potions, he basically did not use it on anyone else.

Since Befuli took the initiative to come to him, Han Xiao did not feel guilty at all. Since he was an enemy, he had to make the best use of him. The ability to shoot fire from the eyes was both cool and strong. He felt that it was very nice.

You have received [Character Summon Card – Befuli (Temporary)].

Character Summon Card – Befuli (Temporary): [Incandescent Eyes]: Shoots out a high-temperature fire pillar from the eyes, causing burning damage. Target with line of sight. Max range: 400 meters. Attack range: 510 – 1360. Generates 3 attacks per second. Lasts for 5 seconds. Number of uses: 0/1. (Character Summon Card will exist for 15 days.)

"Wow, this damage is quite high. As expected of a pure attack Esper Ability!"

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled.

If he could burn for five seconds, the lowest theoretical damage would be over 7,600, and the highest would be … a lot of damage. Furthermore, it was an AOE skill.

Even when facing a Grade B enemy, after deducting the enemy's resistance, he would be able to deal at least 3,000 to 4,000 damage. Furthermore, shooting out from the eyes was equivalent to giving away extra damage.

Han Xiao lowered his head and smiled at Befuli.

"We have to get along well in the future."

Befuli lay on the ground, his body trembling. The way he looked at Han Xiao was like a lamb waiting to be slaughtered. In his eyes, Black Star was more than a hundred times scarier than him, a galactic pirate.

He suddenly had a feeling that his life in the future … might very well be worse than death!

…

Han Xiao managed to find out the existence of his accomplices from Befuli. However, when Befuli failed, the other galactic pirates had already escaped with their spaceships. Han Xiao did not want to waste any time, so he did not turn around to chase after these galactic pirates.

He had already treated the Purple Snake Space Pirates as nourishment for the players in the future, so he was not in a hurry to deal with this organization.

The Blacklight Stealth set off again. After this small episode, they did not stop along the way, so they did not encounter anything else.

A few days later, Floating Dragon Island, which was drifting in the universe, appeared in front of them.

Han Xiao piloted the spaceship and landed. Floating Dragon had already known about the return of this comrade. Wilsander was waiting at the dock to welcome Han Xiao. Logistics Manager Haier was also there. What surprised Han Xiao was that Jenny, who had some unhappiness with him, was also standing at the side with a long face. She was obviously there to welcome him.

"Hahaha, Black Star, you're back again." Wilsander laughed loudly, his tail wagging as he came up to Han Xiao and gave him a big hug.

Han Xiao tilted his head and was almost stabbed in the eye by Wilsander's devil horns.

"Ji ji ji ji …" Haier said something in the Zerg language before realizing that he was not wearing a translator. After putting on the translator with his limbs, he said, "Black Star, did you bring back the rare materials I asked for?"

"They're all on the ship." Han Xiao nodded. After thinking for a while, he added, "Remember to reimburse me. It's very expensive."

Then, Han Xiao turned to look at Jenny and said with surprise, "Why are you here to welcome me?"

"Do you think I want to?" Jenny was expressionless and said unwillingly, "Ames wants to see you."

"Yo, how rare." Han Xiao was a little surprised. Ever since he helped Ames find Aesop, they had not contacted each other. He did not know why she was looking for him this time.

Just as the few of them were chatting, the people at the dock all looked over and whispered to each other. Their eyes were filled with curiosity.

"That's the four troops of Floating Dragon! I didn't expect them to gather together! "

"Is that man in black Floating Dragon's Field Team Black Star? I heard that the Dragon Emperor wants to expand her forces, and Black Star is expanding her armed forces. He has a lot of authority."

"I heard that Black Star stepped into the Garton Star System. I wonder if it was the Dragon Emperor's idea. Could it be that she wants to get involved as well?"

Han Xiao's actions of expanding his mercenary group had already attracted some attention in the galaxy. Many people felt that it was Ames' idea. They thought that this was a signal — the Dragon Emperor, who had always been aloof from worldly affairs, finally wanted to obtain an organization that was comparable to a Beyond Grade A.
